headline: Trump to Decide on South Africa's $1.7 Billion Duty-Free Trade Status
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump is expected to decide whether South Africa will retain preferential access to the American market, affecting $1.7 billion in duty-free exports.
why: Preferential trade agreements directly impact export volumes, corporate revenues, and economic stability for developing nations trading with the United States.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Loss or retention of duty-free access affects South African export competitiveness.
